cases.query: In the 2023 biodiversity amendment, what activities count as access to a biological resource?
cases.anchor: collecting, procuring or possessing any biological resource

cases.query: Which books define codified traditional knowledge under the 2023 amendment?
cases.anchor: authoritative books specified in the First Schedule to the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940

cases.query: How does the 2023 biodiversity amendment define a derivative even without hereditary units?
cases.anchor: naturally occurring biochemical compound or metabolism of biological resources

cases.query: For an Indian registered company, which foreign-control condition is substituted in section 3 by the 2023 amendment?
cases.anchor: which is controlled by a foreigner within the meaning of clause (27)

cases.query: According to the 2023 amendment, what must section 7 applicants do with the NBA before their intellectual property right is granted?
cases.anchor: shall register with the National Biodiversity Authority before grant of such intellectual property rights

cases.query: Under the 2023 amendment, what evidence is needed for the cultivated medicinal plant exemption?
cases.anchor: only if a certificate of origin is obtained from the Biodiversity Management Committee

cases.query: In the 2025 ABS regulations, can upfront benefit sharing be waived for academic research?
cases.anchor: the Authority may waive the benefit sharing including upfront payment

cases.query: For regulation 4 of ABS 2025, when must a business above one crore turnover submit its annual resource-consumption statement?
cases.anchor: within three months of finalisation of annual income tax or corporate tax return

cases.query: Under the 2025 ABS regulations, how much of monetary consideration may be payable when research results are transferred?
cases.anchor: up to five percent. of the monetary consideration

cases.query: In the 2025 ABS regulations, how does traditional knowledge in an invention affect the benefit sharing obligation?
cases.anchor: the benefit sharing obligation shall be twenty-five percent. higher

cases.query: Under the 2025 ABS regulations, which form is used to deposit a novel Indian microbial strain abroad for publication?
cases.anchor: shall apply on the web portal of the Authority in Form E

cases.query: In ABS regulation 11 of 2025, does using several biological resources instead of one change the benefit-sharing amount?
cases.anchor: The amount of benefit sharing shall remain the same whether the product contains one or more biological resources

cases.query: Under the 2025 ABS regulations, what fraction of benefits can the Authority retain and share with the relevant Board?
cases.anchor: a minimum of ten percent. to maximum of fifteen percent. of the accrued benefits shall go to the Authority

cases.query: In the 2025 ABS agreement terms, how quickly must a change of status under section 3(2) be reported?
cases.anchor: intimation shall be given to the Authority or the Board or Council within a period of sixty days

cases.query: Which form do section 3(2) persons use for prior NBA approval before grant of intellectual property rights under the 2024 Rules?
cases.anchor: applying on the web portal of the Authority in Form 7

cases.query: Which registration form is specified for section 7 persons before grant of intellectual property rights in the 2024 Rules?
cases.anchor: shall register on the web portal of the Authority in Form 8

cases.query: What form is required at commercialisation of intellectual property rights for section 7 persons in the 2024 Rules?
cases.anchor: the applicant shall obtain prior approval by applying on the web portal of the Authority in Form 9

cases.query: Under the 2024 Rules, what declaration is needed to use foreign biological resources or traditional knowledge in India?
cases.anchor: shall submit a declaration in Form 10

cases.query: Under the 2024 Rules, which form does an Indian researcher use to send biological resources abroad for non-commercial research?
cases.anchor: shall apply on the web portal of the Authority in Form 13

cases.query: Under rule 17 of the 2024 biodiversity Rules, can false information or violation of conditions lead to revocation?
cases.anchor: has declared false or misleading information or violated any of the provisions

cases.query: When do the Biological Diversity Amendment Rules of 2025 come into force?
cases.anchor: They shall come into force from the 1st day of November, 2025

cases.query: In the substituted rule 19 of 2025, which form is used to apply for a cultivated medicinal plant certificate of origin?
cases.anchor: along with the fee in Form 11A on web portal

cases.query: Under the 2025 amendment, in which form does the Biodiversity Management Committee maintain its cultivation books?
cases.anchor: shall be maintained by the Biodiversity Management Committee in Form 11

cases.query: Under the substituted 2025 procedure, which certificate form is generated from cultivation-book entries?
cases.anchor: the certificate of origin shall be generated in the web portal in the Form ‘12’
